V-M-LINT-CORE.Scenario: Lint CLI integration covers project load, issue codes, and clean fixtures for core lint paths.
V-M-LINT-CORE.TraceAssertion: grace-lint integration tests exercise lint entry points that depend on src/lint/core.ts.

V-M-LINT-TYPES.Scenario: Lint issue records remain additive for issueClass without breaking JSON consumers.
V-M-LINT-TYPES.TraceAssertion: grace-lint integration tests assert issue object shape through objectContaining projections.

V-M-LINT-CATALOG.Scenario: Catalog-backed guides attach for absence and defect codes without silent missing remediations.
V-M-LINT-CATALOG.TraceAssertion: grace-lint integration tests exercise guided issue codes that resolve through the catalog.

V-M-ASSERTIONS.Scenario: Assertion evaluation reports pass, fail, and absence cases without silent success.
V-M-ASSERTIONS.TraceAssertion: assertions unit tests cover Must* shapes and invalid-path handling.

V-M-PROJECT-UTILS.Scenario: Markup scanning and governed-file analysis emit absence codes and ignore string-literal markers.
V-M-PROJECT-UTILS.TraceAssertion: project-utils unit tests cover no-adapter, runtime-missing, and string-literal marker cases.

V-M-GRAMMAR.Scenario: Grammar rejects malformed context, graph, verification, and change artifacts.
V-M-GRAMMAR.TraceAssertion: grammar tests assert required sections and applicability rules.

V-M-STATUS.Scenario: Status CLI reports durable health and next action for active and archive changes.
V-M-STATUS.TraceAssertion: status integration tests pin JSON and table shapes for the status entry point.

V-M-DOCTOR.Scenario: Doctor reports absences by reason, including the zero case and JSON shape with issueClass.
V-M-DOCTOR.TraceAssertion: grace-doctor unit tests cover absence partition, counts by reason, and issueClass visibility.

V-M-SKILLS.Scenario: Canonical skills/ngrace tree stays path-safe and byte-synced with the packaged plugin mirror.
V-M-SKILLS.TraceAssertion: validate-marketplace compares each listed skill directory recursively.

V-M-CURSOR.Scenario: Cursor show is non-writing; fold is write-verify-delete; regenerate is dry-run by default.
V-M-CURSOR.TraceAssertion: grace-cursor unit tests cover fold ordering, concurrent ranges, and recovery.

V-M-ARTIFACT-TYPES.Scenario: Companion registry and ledger/cursor root tags stay load-bearing with validators.
V-M-ARTIFACT-TYPES.TraceAssertion: grammar tests admit run-ledger.xml and run.xml only through the derived allowlist.

V-M-CLI.Scenario: ngrace cursor subcommand is registered on the CLI entry surface.
V-M-CLI.TraceAssertion: cursor command module is imported from grace.ts and exercised by unit tests.

V-M-GATES.Scenario: Gate evaluation permits and refuses approve/apply/archive with required evidence.
V-M-GATES.TraceAssertion: gates unit tests cover decision recording and missing-evidence fail-closed paths.

V-M-REVIEW.Scenario: Review surface emits review.* findings with deterministic IDs and never writes Verdicts.
V-M-REVIEW.TraceAssertion: review unit tests cover pattern detectors, scope audit, and D14 boundary with lint.

V-M-LOCALIZE.Scenario: Localization reports first divergent marker block and admissible review process context.
V-M-LOCALIZE.TraceAssertion: localize unit tests cover comparator axes, foreign markers, and flake consumption.

V-M-QUERY.Scenario: Module and file query resolve graph Path and linked governed files.
V-M-QUERY.TraceAssertion: grace-query integration tests pin JSON shapes for module and file resolution.

V-M-CONTEXT.Scenario: Task slices project GraphAnchors modules with Linked Files from governed LINKS.
V-M-CONTEXT.TraceAssertion: grace-context unit tests cover Purpose, selectedBytes, and skill subsetting.

V-M-TEST-SUPPORT.Scenario: Temp project fixtures and defect corpus seed stable, deterministic test projects.
V-M-TEST-SUPPORT.TraceAssertion: test-support tests cover fixture builders and corpus pattern ids.
